notes: Only the final 140 alternating runs determine performance gates. Earlier failed tests and unqualified-table diagnostics remain in their original receipts.

Task and overlap clocks sum wall time and include mutex waits; they do not measure OS CPU utilization. GPU callback time includes coordinator graph/source preparation and is not precise device busy time.

The case pool begins before graph construction, admits at most 64 outstanding jobs, and joins before borrowed sources or reservations retire. All output publication remains ordered on the coordinator.
Numeric identity and leaf shards are per request. The last shard assembles the request on its worker without nested pools or a global request barrier.
Uncached early numeric work defers to ordinary planning after the case pool joins. Cached-only warmup neither compiles descriptors nor borrows an unfunded compiler reservation.
Native recording requirements are sealed into prepared values and reused only after original source/profile/descriptor checks.

GPU field streams use at most 64 streams and a fixed 131072-word input window; tiles end on four-word boundaries, carry state/status stays on device, and every absorption still canonicalizes field elements.

N3 timings use two deterministic fixtures. N4 fixtures compose four distinct public inputs from those files and independently verify each proof before profiling. Their exact composition is recorded separately.
Documentation and this evidence are added after the measured source snapshot.

selection.reason: Earlier CPU scheduling improves complete N3 time on both fixtures. Borrowed tiled streams preserve that gain with a small additional reduction in the screens. Fused remains available for qualification; both N3 screening and six larger GPU workloads favor paired. N4 complete comparison remains subject to its explicit worker-memory profile choice.
selection.n4_complete_comparison: pending explicit research profile selection after standard32 admission refusal

diagnostic_notes: Initial GPU screening preceded table requalification and incurred 194 cold misses; it is excluded from performance comparisons.

Early AES focused failures exposed compiler-reservation validation on cached-only warmup. The final path performs lookup-only warming and defers misses without starting a compiler; subsequent focused tests pass.
The first N4 replay retained a three-member fixture owner and was refused before graph construction. The fixture owner now carries the verified N3/N4 member count.
The first large GPU test used a full-profile output allowance larger than its eight-GiB test context and was refused at startup. The matched eight-GiB guarded test passes all six shapes.

N4 standard-memory attempts reach final combined admission at both one and sixteen workers and require 410489118 host bytes above the 32-GiB cap. They are not complete-stage timings. An explicit 36-GiB N4-only trial was requested from the user and has not been authorized or executed.
